description: The line plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” — the proportion of harmful responses in which the model exhibited a rejection tendency — across four different model-benchmark combinations, plotted against increasing input sequence lengths (128, 256, 512, and 1024 tokens). The x-axis, labeled with these discrete token lengths, spans from 128 to 1024 and uses a linear scale with no units specified. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1 and also uses a linear scale. Four distinct lines represent the models: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles, solid line) starts at ~0.20 and rises to ~0.36; Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares, solid line) begins at ~0.15, climbs to ~0.42 at 512, and plateaus at ~0.42 at 1024; LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles, solid line) starts at ~0.06, rises sharply to ~0.37 at 512, and slightly increases to ~0.38 at 1024; Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds, solid line) begins at ~0.24, rises to ~0.42 at 512, and continues increasing to ~0.52 at 1024. All lines show an upward trend, with Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench exhibiting the steepest overall increase and highest final value.
